caption: The drawing depicts a single rocking chair placed at the center of a neutral, off-white background. The chair features a wooden frame with elegant, curving arms and rockers; the arms envelope a carved swan motif at their support posts. The wood is rendered in brown tones with darker shading to define the form. The seat, backrest, and armrest pads are upholstered in a light yellow fabric decorated with a regular pattern of pale blue and white dots. The composition shows the chair in profile, facing left, prominently displaying its carved arm detail and the continuous wooden rocker runners. There are no other objects or background details present in the drawing.
title: Rocking Chair
